name: Lake Balaton
title: Holidays in Lake Balaton
intro: Central Europe's largest lake, with shallow warm water, wine hills, a peninsula of lavender and lively summer resorts. Here's what Lake Balaton is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Tihany's twin-towered abbey above red poppies by Lake Balaton
facts_note: Hungary is in the Schengen area, so the new EU entry checks apply. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: June to September is best, when the lake is warm, often 24°C or more, and the resorts are open. July and August are busy with Hungarian families. The wine harvest is in autumn, and the lake is very quiet in winter.

things.name: Tihany
things.blurb: A hilly peninsula with a hilltop abbey, lavender fields and an echo.

things.name: Lake swimming
things.blurb: Warm, shallow water on the south shore, great for small children.

things.name: Hévíz
things.blurb: A warm thermal lake where you can swim even in winter.

things.name: Badacsony
things.blurb: Volcanic wine hills on the north shore, with wineries and views.

things.name: Keszthely
things.blurb: A lakeside town with the grand Festetics Palace.

things.name: Cycle around the lake
things.blurb: A 200 km bike path circles the whole lake.

faqs.question: Is Lake Balaton worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for families. The water is shallow and warm, prices are good, and wine country and thermal baths are close by.

faqs.question: How do you get to Lake Balaton?
faqs.answer: Fly into Budapest, then take the train or drive, about 1 hour 30 minutes. Hévíz-Balaton airport has a few seasonal flights.

faqs.question: Which side of Lake Balaton is best?
faqs.answer: The south shore has shallow, sandy beaches for families. The north shore is hillier, with vineyards and prettier villages.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Lake Balaton?
Is Lake Balaton good for children?
faqs.answer: Very. The south shore is so shallow you can walk out a long way.
